page_title: LIV 2-0 EVE | Liverpool v Everton 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Beto (Everton) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
90+7' 2 - 0 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) collects a sweet pass and fires a shot inside the right post. What a brilliant shot!
90+6' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
90+5' Flag goes up against Chermiti (Everton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+3' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
90+1' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
90+1' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.

90' That was a nice football moment. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Jordan Pickford guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) comes to nothing.
88' It's time for a substitution. Chermiti (Everton) comes on in place of Vitali Mykolenko.

88' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
86' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
85' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
82' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His header goes to the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford is alert and manages to keep the ball out.
82' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
81' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Luis Diaz and he is replaced by Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
80' A substitution has been made. Amadou Onana goes off and Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) comes on.
80' Dangerous play by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) plays a through ball but overhits it.
78' Liverpool are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
75' 1 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jordan Pickford into right side of the goal.
75' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
74' It’s a PENALTY to Liverpool after the VAR review!
73' There's a break in play and referee Craig Pawson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Liverpool using VAR. This could be interesting!
73' Michael Keane (Everton) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
72' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Liverpool! Play can continue.
72' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Liverpool. Let’s see what happens!
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Luis Diaz (Liverpool) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
69' The foul by Beto (Everton) was seen by Craig Pawson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
67' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ibrahima Konate as he is replaced by Joel Matip (Liverpool).
66' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Diogo Jota (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.

66' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jordan Pickford pulls off an easy save.
65' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
64' An attempted cross from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is cleared.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Ryan Gravenberch cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) replacing Konstantinos Tsimikas.
61' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin makes his way off the pitch and Beto (Everton) comes on as his replacement.
61' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
59' The linesman signals that Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
58' Amadou Onana (Everton) is able to continue to play.
57' Looks like Amadou Onana (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' James Garner (Everton) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
54' A cross by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
54' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
52' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
52' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
48' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Sean Dyche makes a half-time substitution. Nathan Patterson comes on in place of Dwight McNeil (Everton).
46' Half-time substitution. Jack Harrison (Everton) will not participate anymore and Michael Keane is coming on.
46' The whistle blows and Craig Pawson starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+2' A wild pass somehow finds Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' What a poor attempt! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
45' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner with a short pass.

44' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
44' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
44' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
43' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
41' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alisson reads it well and gathers the ball.

41' Dwight McNeil (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Everton can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jordan Pickford scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
40' The resulting corner from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is cleared.
40' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
39' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.

39' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
37' Ashley Young (Everton) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
35' A cross into the box from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared.
34' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Jordan Pickford.
34' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
33' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
32' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to James Tarkowski (Everton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
29' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
27' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes a short corner kick.
25' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
24' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
22' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after James Tarkowski (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
21' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the box from the free kick, but Alisson guesses his intention and plucks the ball out of the air.
20' The referee blows his whistle as Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) was too aggressive in his challenge.
20' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Ashley Young (Everton) for his blatant foul.
17' The corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is intercepted by Alisson.
17' A cross from Jack Harrison (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
16' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
15' Jack Harrison (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) commits a foul and Craig Pawson immediately signals a free kick.
14' The corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is cleared away by the defence.
13' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
13' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Dwight McNeil (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Everton win a corner.
11' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

10' He should have scored! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
10' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Luis Diaz (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off the line to clear the ball away.
7' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) plays a through ball but overhits it.
5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

1' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson pulls off a great save to deny him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Everton will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
